title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 8: The Left Hand's Ring Finger
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Sato, Takagi, Inspector Megure) omitted by convention, including the Sato/Takagi ring-and-engagement B-plot that frames the episode -- it never touches the murder-case graph. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old lower-fidelity case file's culprit (Dejima) and core trick (cassette tape strung through the ring/key to fake a locked-room suicide) both check out against the transcript -- no reversal here, unlike some other rebuilds. What the old file missed: Akiba's backstory role as a colleague of all three suspects (not just a private grievance of Dejima's), the two red-herring trick theories floated and disproven on-screen (Tarumi's rubber bands, Anabuki's metal tape measure), the pencil used to quietly rewind the tape, and the ambiguity in how directly Moroguchi caused Akiba's death (transcript says Moroguchi directed Akiba to test his murder tricks on his own body 'taking meticulous care not to die for real' -- the fatal test was ruled a suicide, not stated on-screen as Moroguchi personally administering it, so modeled here as `exploits` rather than `kills`). case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Moroguchi never removed his ring and wasn't the type to misalign it, yet it was found put back on upside down -- someone else removed and replaced it after his death.

The faded blood ring around the victim's finger has one strip rubbed clean, matching where a thin cord would have slid under the ring -- that residue should be findable on the cassette tape Dejima carries.
